title: Achha Bura
overview: Shekhar and Birsingh are bosom pals. They come to stay at a small chawl where an angry woman confronts them. But when their hatred turns into love and oneness they form a sister-brother relationship, willing to lay down their lives for each other. On the other side, there are two lovers – Ravi and Rita. Shekhar and Birsingh are also strangely related to Rita.

songs.title: Tum Bhi Hanso Hum Bhi Hanse
songs.singers: Usha Mangeshkar, Usha Khanna, Anwar Hussain, Suresh Wadkar
